sample:
The Contractor shall provide qualified project supervision
and management for all phases of the work, including
scheduling, coordination, quality control, and progress
tracking. Industry-standard construction management
software shall be utilized for project documentation,
communication, reporting, and scheduling. All work shall
be performed in full compliance with OSHA regulations,
with properly trained and certified personnel maintaining
a safe job site. The Contractor shall perform routine site
housekeeping throughout construction and provide
complete final cleanup upon project completion.

The contractor shall be responsible for obtaining and
maintaining all required permits, coordinating and
scheduling required inspections, and complying with all
applicable local, state, and federal regulations. The
contractor shall provide all necessary reports, engineering
documentation, testing results, and inspection records
related to the foundation repair work. Any required
material, soil, concrete, or structural testing shall be
arranged by the contractor, and all deficiencies identified
through testing or inspection shall be corrected at no
additional cost unless otherwise specified in the contract.

The contractor shall be responsible for mobilization and
demobilization of all personnel, equipment, tools,
materials, temporary facilities, traffic control measures,
and site protection necessary to complete the work.
Mobilization shall include transporting resources to and
from the project site, establishing safe work areas, and
coordinating activities to ensure efficient project
execution in accordance with contract requirements and
applicable safety standards.
